maintenance_led.reason: Mostly engineered bearings and power transmission products sold to OEMs and distributors; aftermarket is significant but not clearly the majority.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial manufacturers and distributors across industrial, energy, automation; aerospace/defense is a minor share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own engineered bearings and motion products; makes occasional bolt-on acquisitions like Groenveld-BEKA, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered bearings and drive systems are qualified into customers' equipment; switching requires re-qualification and risks downtime.

notes: Maintenance-led is uncertain because Timken sells through both OEM and aftermarket/distribution channels.
